XData.name: DTL
XData.Data: <transform sourceClass='IHC.ITF.DStruct.Record.ShDemogrBatchFileToCff.Record' targetClass='EnsLib.EDI.XML.Document' targetDocType='PatientServiceUpdatePatientRequest:initiatePatientService' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>DTL for SelectHealth demographics to Initiate patient service - Add/Update </annotation> <assign value='"100:HealthPlans"' property='target.{application}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.address1' property='homeAddress' action='set' /> <if condition='$length(homeAddress) > 9' > <true> <assign value='homeAddress' property='target.{patient.addresses(1).line1}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.address2' property='target.{patient.addresses(1).line2}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.city' property='target.{patient.addresses(1).city}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.state' property='target.{patient.addresses(1).state}' action='set' /> <if condition='$length(source.zip) > 5' > <true> <assign value='$E(source.zip,1,5)' property='target.{patient.addresses(1).zip}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='source.country' property='target.{patient.addresses(1).country}' action='set' /> <assign value='"HOMEADDR"' property='target.{patient.addresses(1).type}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='source.homephone' property='srcHomePhNumber' action='set' /> <if condition='$length(srcHomePhNumber) > 9' > <true> <assign value='$extract(srcHomePhNumber,4,10)' property='target.{patient.phones(1).phoneNumber}' action='set' /> <assign value='$extract(srcHomePhNumber,1,3)' property='target.{patient.phones(1).areaCode}' action='set' /> <assign value='"HOMEPHONE"' property='target.{patient.phones(1).phoneType}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='source.businessphone' property='srcOfficePhNumber' action='set' /> <if condition='$length(srcOfficePhNumber) > 9' > <true> <assign value='$extract(srcOfficePhNumber,4,10)' property='target.{patient.phones(1).phoneNumber}' action='set' /> <assign value='$extract(srcOfficePhNumber,1,3)' property='target.{patient.phones(1).areaCode}' action='set' /> <assign value='"OFFICEPHONE"' property='target.{patient.phones(1).phoneType}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='context.modifiedMidName' property='target.{patient.names(1).middleName}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.modifiedLastName' property='target.{patient.names(1).familyName}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.modifiedFirstName' property='target.{patient.names(1).givenName}' action='set' /> <if condition='$length(source.email) > 0' > <true> <assign value='source.email' property='target.{patient.emails(1).address}' action='set' /> <assign value='"HOMEEMAIL"' property='target.{patient.emails(1).type}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='source.subscriberid_source.membersuffix' property='target.{patient.sourceMrns(1).mrn}' action='set' /> <assign value='"1450530"' property='target.{patient.sourceMrns(1).assigningAuthority}' action='set' /> <if condition='context.BadSSN="false"' > <true> <assign value='source.ssn' property='target.{patient.ssn}' action='set' /> </true> <false> <assign value='""' property='target.{patient.ssn}' action='set' /> </false> </if> <assign value='context.gender' property='target.{patient.genderType}' action='set' /> <if condition='(source.birthdatetime > 8)' > <true> <assign value='$E(source.birthdatetime,0,8)' property='target.{patient.dateOfBirth}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='"A04"' property='target.{transactionType}' action='set' /> <assign value='"1450530"' property='target.{transactionFacility}' action='set' /> <assign value='$ZSTRIP($ZDATETIME($HOROLOG,8,1),"*"," :")' property='target.{transactionTime}' action='set' /> </transform>
